Q0021

Epicurus

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Epicurus / Q0021

English

Of all that wisdom provides for the happiness of a whole life, by far the greatest is the possession of friendship.
Thinker Epicurus
School Epicureanism
Source Principal Doctrines XXVII
Theme Friendship
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Principal Doctrines XXVII, within the tradition of Epicureanism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of friendship, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Epicurus's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
